title: Simple Variable Mass 6DOF Wind (Quaternion)
text: 实现相对于风轴的简单变质量六自由度运动方程的四元数表示，输入 4 路、输出 12 路；按 {Mass type} 指定质量类型 Simple；{Units}、{Representation}、{Initial position in inertial axes [Xe,Ye,Ze]}、{Initial airspeed, angle of attack, and sideslip angle [V,alpha,beta]}、{Initial wind orientation [bank angle,flight path angle,heading angle]}、{Initial body rotation rates [p,q,r]}、{Initial mass}、{Empty mass}、{Full mass}、{Inertia in body axis}、{Empty inertia matrix in body axis}、{Full inertia matrix in body axis}、{Include mass flow relative velocity}、{Include inertial acceleration}、{Position: e.g., ’Xe’,’Ye’,’Ze’}、{Velocity: e.g., ’V’}、{Incidence angle e.g., ’alpha’}、{Sideslip angle e.g., ’beta’}、{Wind orientation e.g., ’mu’, ’gamma’, ’chi’}、{Quaternion vector: e.g., ’qr’,’qi’,’qj’,’qk’}、{Body rotation rates: e.g., ’p’,’q’,’r’}、{Mass: e.g., ’mass’} 同样影响行为。

ports.summary: 平面地球参考坐标系中的速度 three-element vector

ports.summary: 风固定坐标系中的速度 three-element vector

ports.summary: 体固连坐标系中的角加速度 three-element vector

ports.name: A be

params.name: Units
params.values: 输入和输出单位 Metric (MKS) (default) | English (Velocity in ft/s) | English (Velocity in kts)

params.name: Mass type
params.values: 质量类型 Simple Variable (default) | Fixed | Custom Variable

params.name: Representation
params.values: 运动方程表示 Quaternion (default) | Wind Angles

params.name: Initial position in inertial axes [Xe,Ye,Ze]
params.values: 惯性坐标轴中的位置 [0 0 0] (default) | three-element vector

params.name: Initial airspeed, angle of attack, and sideslip angle [V,alpha,beta]
params.values: 初始空速、迎角和侧滑角 [0 0 0] (default) | three-element vector

params.name: Initial wind orientation [bank angle,flight path angle,heading angle]
params.values: 初始风朝向 [0 0 0] (default) | three-element vector

params.name: Initial body rotation rates [p,q,r]
params.values: 初始机体旋转 [0 0 0] (default) | three-element vector

params.name: Initial mass
params.values: 初始质量 1.0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Empty mass
params.values: 空载质量 0.5 (default) | scalar

params.name: Full mass
params.values: 机体的满载质量 2.0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Inertia in body axis
params.values: 机体惯性 eye(3) (default) | scalar

params.name: Empty inertia matrix in body axis
params.values: 空载惯量的惯性张量矩阵 eye(3) (default) | 3-by-3 matrix

params.name: Full inertia matrix in body axis
params.values: 满载惯量的惯性张量矩阵 2*eye(3) (default) | 3-by-3 matrix

params.name: Include mass flow relative velocity
params.values: 质量流相对速度端口 off (default) | on

params.name: Include inertial acceleration
params.values: 包括惯性加速度端口 off (default) | on

params.name: Position: e.g., {’Xe’,’Ye’,’Ze’}
params.values: 位置状态名称 ’’ (default) | comma-separated list surrounded by braces

params.name: Velocity: e.g., ’V’
params.values: 速度状态名称 ’’ (default) | character vector

params.name: Incidence angle e.g., ’alpha’
params.values: 入射角状态名称 ’’ (default) | character vector

params.name: Sideslip angle e.g., ’beta’
params.values: 侧滑角状态名称 ’’ (default) | character vector

params.name: Wind orientation e.g., {’mu’, ’gamma’, ’chi’}
params.values: 风朝向状态名称 ’’ (default) | comma-separated list surrounded by braces

params.name: Quaternion vector: e.g., {’qr’,’qi’,’qj’,’qk’}
params.values: 四元数向量状态名称 ’’ (default) | comma-separated list surrounded by braces

params.name: Body rotation rates: e.g., {’p’,’q’,’r’}
params.values: 机体旋转状态名称 ’’ (default) | comma-separated list surrounded by braces
